given_when: No active session opens protected organization route
expected_design_behavior: Redirect to managed login; no protected SSR payload or hidden records

given_when: Expired session uses previously bookmarked organization overview
expected_design_behavior: Require fresh verified session; do not leak cached tenant summary

given_when: Verified user creates separate fictional workspace
expected_design_behavior: Create-only new tenant action proposed; no claim to existing org

given_when: Invitation token expired or revoked
expected_design_behavior: No active membership; safe one-time proof failure, never display tenant roster

given_when: Verified email/identity does not match invitee
expected_design_behavior: Reject without disclosing full invitation/org details

given_when: Signed-in identity has zero active org memberships
expected_design_behavior: Safe empty organization chooser; no foreign org enumeration

given_when: Same verified identity belongs to Orchid and Juniper demo orgs
expected_design_behavior: Show only verified active workspaces; choose target deliberately

given_when: Directly type orgId belonging to unjoined tenant
expected_design_behavior: Safe 403/404; no org name, hidden counts or record IDs

given_when: ORG_OWNER lacks leads:R despite membership
expected_design_behavior: Hide Leads nav and deny direct lead-list URL

given_when: ORG_ADMIN lacks merchant_applications:R
expected_design_behavior: Hide queue and deny direct route, no hidden merchant names

given_when: SALES_REP has permitted leads:R for assigned records
expected_design_behavior: Lead list contains only assigned/team-scoped allowlisted fields

given_when: Sales role can list but not create leads
expected_design_behavior: Do not display New Lead action; direct create page safe denied

given_when: Sales role has leads:R but not U/M
expected_design_behavior: Read-only lead detail; edit/transition controls absent and API still denies

given_when: Assigned coordinator sees one internal application
expected_design_behavior: Owner/internal stage/next action visible, safe status provenance labeled

given_when: Member guesses application ID from other tenant
expected_design_behavior: Safe 404/403; no title, owner, stage or next action leaked

given_when: Allowed application detail but no checklist read permission
expected_design_behavior: Checklist tab omitted/denied without hidden count

given_when: User lacks application_stage_history:R
expected_design_behavior: History tab and direct URL denied; no number of changes shown

given_when: User has read but not stage transition grant
expected_design_behavior: Stage control not active; direct write route future server denies

given_when: Application references DEMO_ONLY_ACTIVE synthetic_unverified
expected_design_behavior: Display DEMO/UNVERIFIED, not real processor-approved or charges-enabled

given_when: User follows guessed /kyc route or tries upload
expected_design_behavior: No usable intake/upload, safe unavailable; never store raw document

given_when: User navigates guessed /payments route
expected_design_behavior: No charge/refund/checkout screen or payment authorization

given_when: EXTERNAL_AGENT attempts internal org UI
expected_design_behavior: No self-service portal or implicit membership, safe deny

given_when: Allowed billing viewer opens mock billing reference
expected_design_behavior: Show Demo plan / no charges; no real checkout/card info

given_when: Billing viewer guesses lead URL
expected_design_behavior: Only billing permission; unrelated CRM record access denied

given_when: Reviewer views sanitized permitted audit trail
expected_design_behavior: No request body, contacts, secrets or complete KYC data exposed

given_when: Agent assignment revoked in current tenant
expected_design_behavior: Former portfolio hidden and direct URL denied on next protected request

given_when: User switches Orchid to Juniper via org switcher
expected_design_behavior: Cancel pending fetch, clear scoped cache, reverify membership and nav, never flash old data

given_when: Switch org while unsaved synthetic lead form is open
expected_design_behavior: Prompt before discard/route switch and do not cross-save form into target tenant

given_when: User goes back to prior-org record URL after switch
expected_design_behavior: Re-check actual permission; no old-org SSR or cached content visible

given_when: Manager loads stalled-case report
expected_design_behavior: Totals count only authorized records before aggregation; no foreign group leakage

given_when: Filter returns no visible leads but hidden leads exist
expected_design_behavior: Show No results matching filters; never leak hidden record count

given_when: User entitled app but assigned zero visible applications
expected_design_behavior: Safe No permitted records state, not company has zero merchants

given_when: 320px device opens workspace nav
expected_design_behavior: Accessible drawer labels, focus/return behavior and no clipped primary action

given_when: User moves deal using only keyboard
expected_design_behavior: Provide keyboard stage alternative and announce invalid/stale write future state

given_when: Another operator updates version while current UI open
expected_design_behavior: Show conflict/reload, don't claim saved state or append history twice

given_when: Connection goes offline during task update
expected_design_behavior: Explain Changes not saved with safe retry, no false save

given_when: Merchant create form proposes bank/PAN/KYC fields
expected_design_behavior: Prohibit field, do not add route/file upload or persist identity/payment data

given_when: User searches contacts globally
expected_design_behavior: Future search scope restricted to active org, permitted records and field projections

given_when: Merchant Ops entitlement disabled but guessed queue URL entered
expected_design_behavior: Module nav disabled/hidden by policy, direct request safely rejected

given_when: Marketing app launcher lists future commissions module
expected_design_behavior: May show Coming later to authorized viewers but never active route
